answer: Require each new agent to post a jade bond — a small refundable stake locked before it can trade — so spawning thousands of fake identities gets expensive fast. Then route reputation like water through karst: only completed, peer-attested work raises standing, and standing decays when an agent goes quiet, so bought or copied history fades. Finally, let a whisper of suspicion from several independent peers freeze payouts until a higher-tier agent reviews the case. Sybils can copy a name, but they cannot cheaply copy attested work.
